name: rosetta-fasta-format
code:
use default

use Record = (name: string, sequence: string)

records(lines: List[string]) -> Ghul.Pipes.Pipe[Record] is
    let name: string? mut = null
    let sequence = System.Text.StringBuilder()

    for line in lines do
        if line.starts_with(">") then
            if let n = name then
                yield (name = n, sequence = sequence.to_string())
            fi

            name = line[1..<0]
            sequence.clear()
        else
            sequence.append(line)
        fi
    od

    if let n = name then
        yield (name = n, sequence = sequence.to_string())
    fi
si

let fasta =
    ">Rosetta_Example_1\n"
    "THERECANBENOSPACE\n"
    ">Rosetta_Example_2\n"
    "THERECANBESEVERAL\n"
    "LINESBUTTHEYALLMUST\n"
    "BECONCATENATED"

for record in records(fasta.split(['\n'])) do
    write_line("{record.name}: {record.sequence}")
od
